notes.dictionary: Production deterministic rules without semantic fallback.
notes.current_hybrid: Production dictionary plus current MiniLM fallback. May load sentence-transformers.
notes.tfidf_word: Classical TF-IDF cosine over symptom candidate documents using word n-grams.
notes.tfidf_char: Classical TF-IDF cosine over symptom candidate documents using character n-grams for typo tolerance.
notes.tfidf_hybrid: Max score from word and character TF-IDF retrievers.
notes.qwen3_embedding_0_6b: Optional modern embedding experiment. Heavy on CPU.
notes.bge_m3: Optional BGE-M3 embedding experiment. Heavy on CPU.
notes.jina_v3: Optional Jina Embeddings v3 experiment. Heavy on CPU.
notes.minilm_qwen3_rerank: Optional retrieval plus reranking experiment. Likely slow on CPU.
